name: @w6w-apps/deepl
description: Translate text and documents, manage glossaries, and check quota via the DeepL API.

w6w.longDescription:
DeepL translates text and documents and manages the glossaries that keep specific terms consistent across translations. Run a translation with a source and target language, or hand off a document for background translation — upload, poll status, then download the finished file, since large documents can take minutes and don't fit a single blocking call.

The app follows DeepL's own account-tier split without needing separate configuration: Free and Pro keys route to different hosts automatically based on the key itself, so the same connection setup works either way. Reading usage — characters translated against the plan limit, and document count where a cap applies — gives a workflow a way to check quota before spending it on a large job.

A good fit for translating support tickets, product content or documents as part of a larger workflow, especially where consistent terminology matters enough to maintain a glossary rather than translating cold each time.
